q: Change the voice: 'People speak English all over the world'
o: English is spoken by all over the world.
English is spoken all over the world.
English is spoken in all over the world by the people.
English was spoken all over the world.
e: 'People', 'someone', 'they'-এর মতো অনির্দিষ্ট কর্তা (indefinite agent) passive voice-এ সাধারণত বাদ দেওয়া হয়। তাই সঠিক রূপ 'English is spoken all over the world.' মূল বাক্য present indefinite, তাই passive-এ am/is/are + past participle (spoken) বসবে। Object 'English' singular, তাই is বসেছে। Option ক-তে 'by' আছে কিন্তু agent নেই, তাই এটি অসম্পূর্ণ। Option গ-তে 'in all over' ভুল, কারণ all over-এর আগে in বসে না। Option ঘ-তে was দেওয়ায় tense বদলে গেছে। একই নিয়মে 'Someone has stolen my pen'-এর passive হয় 'My pen has been stolen.'

o: When did Ashraf's mother born him?
When was Ashraf's mother born him?
When did Ashraf's mother bear him?
When was Ashraf being born to his mother?

q: Let them repair the car. (Passive)
o: Let the car being repaired by them.
Let the car been repaired by them.

q: Change the voice of the sentence: I saw him cross the road.
o: He was seen cross the road.
He was seen to cross the road.
He is seen to cross the road.
He was seen crossing the road.
e: See, hear, watch-জাতীয় perception verb-এর পরে active বাক্যে bare infinitive (cross) থাকে। Passive করলে object he হয় subject, was seen বসে এবং হারানো to ফিরে আসে, তাই He was seen to cross the road। Cross বা crossing দিয়ে ভিন্নভাবে লিখলে নিয়ম মানা হয় না, আর is seen বর্তমান কালের, যা মূল বাক্যের অতীতের সঙ্গে মেলে না।

q: His conduct annoyed me. (Make it passive)
o: I was annoyed to his conduct.
I was annoyed with his conduct.
I was annoyed at his conduct.
I was annoyed from his conduct.

q: They heard him sing a song. [passive]
o: He was heard to sing a song by them.
He was heard sang a song by them.
He heard to sing a song by them.
He was heard sing a song by them.

o: The books read well when read.

q: Send me a letter. (Make it passive)
o: Let a letter be send to me.
Let a letter be sent for me.
Let a letter being sent by me.
Let a letter be sent me.
e: Verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া imperative বাক্যের passive-এ Let দিয়ে শুরু হয়। নিয়ম: Let + active-এর object + be + verb-এর past participle। অনেক সময় active-এর subject বা object-এর আগে by-এর বদলে অন্য preposition আসে। তাই Send me a letter-এর passive Let a letter be sent for me। be-এর পরে send নয়, past participle sent বসে।

q: She decided to finish the work. (make it passive)
o: She decided that the work has to be finished.
She decided that the work to be finished.
She decided that the work is being finished.
She decided that the work should be finished.

q: Water the plants daily. (Change the voice)
o: Let daily the plants be watered.
The plants be watered daily.
Let the plants be watered daily.
Let the plants daily be watered.
e: কেবল মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া Imperative বাক্য passive করতে প্রথমে Let বসে। এরপর active-এর object হয়ে যায় subject, তারপর be এবং মূল verb-এর past participle বসে। গঠন: Let + object + be + past participle + বাকি অংশ। তাই Water the plants daily হয়ে যায় Let the plants be watered daily। বাকি অপশনে Let নেই বা daily শব্দটি ভুল জায়গায় বসেছে।

q: Will she complete the mission? (Make it passive)
o: Will be the mission completed by her?
Will be the mission complet by her?
Will the mission completed by her?
Will the mission be completed by her?

q: Let me do the sum. (make it passive)
o: Let the sum be done me
Let me be done the sum
Let the sum be done
Let the sum be done by me
e: Let দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া active বাক্যের passive গঠন: Let + object + be + past participle + by + subject-এর objective রূপ। তাই 'Let me do the sum'-এর passive হয় 'Let the sum be done by me'। এখানে object 'the sum' সামনে আসে, do-এর past participle 'done' বসে, আর কর্তা 'me' by-এর পরে যায়। বিকল্প গ-তে 'by me' বাদ পড়েছে, অথচ কর্তা নির্দিষ্ট হলে তা রাখতে হয়। ক ও খ বিকল্পে শব্দের ক্রম ভুল। একই নিয়মের আরেকটি উদাহরণ: Let him open the door → Let the door be opened by him.
